summary: Use text instead of command to parse earlier output or a file's contents, with template_path or os and command to locate the template.
questions: How do I parse output from a previous task with cli_parse?
Can cli_parse parse a text file?

answer_card.title: Parse existing text
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    text: "{{ output['stdout'] }}"
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      template_path: /home/user/templates/filename.yaml

- ansible.utils.cli_parse:
    text: "{{ lookup('file', 'path/to/file.txt') }}"
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      template_path: /home/user/templates/filename.yaml

- ansible.utils.cli_parse:      # uses templates/nxos_show_version.yaml
    text: "{{ sho_version['stdout'] }}"
    parser:
      name: ansible.netcommon.native
      os: nxos
      command: show version
```
